title: Funnel Maintenance Modernization — Authority Without Theater
page0: Audit and modernize the Funnel itself. Preserve the behavior that is producing strong results, but find semantic, theatrical, roundabout or duplicated logic that increases maintenance cost without increasing correctness. Make documentation and receipts prove what is actually implemented, wired, exercised and authoritative. Keep the 3D representation accurate to the real machine state.
correctedQuestion: Which Funnel mechanisms are essential control laws, which are useful reasoning machinery, which are duplicated or ceremonial representations of the same invariant, and what is the safest sequence for simplifying maintenance without reducing intent fidelity, anti-bypass protection, traceability or result quality?
objective: Reduce maintenance entropy while preserving or improving the Funnel's proven output quality and authority guarantees.

knownEvidence.claim: v44 production authority defines immutable Page 0, ordered replay and receipt-gated Harness execution.
Production request authority is a small deterministic kernel.
Ultra candidate now has native Page 0 replay, typed receipt ordering, staleness and recursive society support.
Maintenance truth already distinguishes documented, implemented, wired, verified, receipt-backed and visualized.
The Citadel is already a truthful observability surface rather than execution authority.
Good observed results imply useful machinery, but good outcomes alone do not identify which internal loops are necessary.

openQuestions: Which current Funnel stages change authority or irreversible state, and which only restate information already available elsewhere?
Where is the same invariant enforced in more than one subsystem, and is that duplication deliberate defense-in-depth or accidental maintenance debt?
Which semantic labels are difficult for a new maintainer to map to executable behavior?
Which receipts are consumed by downstream code rather than merely archived or displayed?
Which event or receipt types have never been exercised by a real current workflow?
Where can a simpler data contract replace prose-mediated handoffs without reducing expressiveness?
Which current loops exist because of historical UI constraints that no longer apply?
Which candidate Ultra mechanisms demonstrably improve v44, and which remain complexity without production value?
What minimum persistent ledger is required before Ultra could ever replace v44 production authority?
How should the system detect documentation drift automatically rather than through repository archaeology?
What maintenance indicators would have warned that later dashboard rebuilds erased Beam wiring?
What are the smallest regression corpora that meaningfully detect intent-fidelity regressions during Funnel simplification?
assumptions: v44 remains production authority during this program.
Ultra remains a candidate until separate promotion criteria are met.
Existing strong outputs are treated as evidence to preserve behavior, not proof that every documented subsystem is required.
Simplification must be evidence-driven and reversible.
nonGoals: Do not rewrite the entire Funnel from scratch.
Do not remove stages solely because their names sound complicated.
Do not promote Ultra as part of maintenance cleanup.
Do not use the 3D environment as evidence that logic works.
Do not optimize for fewer files at the expense of clearer authority boundaries.

maintenanceTaxonomy.definition: Mechanism directly prevents invalid execution, mutation, stale authority or unlawful promotion.
Improves answer quality, decomposition, evidence gathering or convergence but does not itself authorize execution.
Makes state legible to humans/agents but must not create authority.
Exists to preserve older consumers or migration paths.
Intentional independent check of a critical invariant.
Duplicated, unreachable, unused or roundabout mechanism with no measured safety/quality benefit.
Insufficient evidence; must not be deleted until exercised or traced.

interfaces.contract: All novel build/change requests enter one authority boundary.
Only verified production execution receipt authorizes build.
Candidate can be tested but cannot self-promote.
Visualization reflects truth states without upgrading them.
Verification state derives from named tests and current execution results.

failureModes.risk: A seemingly ceremonial stage is actually carrying an implicit invariant.
failureModes.containment: Require dependency trace + adversarial regression before removal.

failureModes.risk: v44 and Ultra both appear authoritative to builders.
failureModes.containment: One production authority field in machine-readable entry + CI invariant.

failureModes.risk: A failing early test prevents later subsystem health from being observed.
failureModes.containment: Independent maintenance sweep with per-station results.
Generate documentation status from runtime/CI evidence where possible.

failureModes.risk: 3D representation remains green after a subsystem degrades.
failureModes.containment: No visual healthy state without evidence token from maintenance register.

failureModes.risk: Future agents cannot tell why a loop exists.
failureModes.containment: Each retained non-obvious mechanism gets purpose, consumer and retirement condition.

maintenanceModel.cadence: Run on every Funnel-law or routing change; produce a station-level report even if unrelated UI tests fail.
maintenanceModel.retirementRule: A mechanism can be removed only when its authority/reasoning benefit is proven redundant and the replacement passes the same regression corpus.
maintenanceModel.debtBudget: New Funnel mechanisms require an owner, explicit invariant, named consumer and retirement/review condition.

observability.human: Citadel maintenance stations show authority owner, live-path wiring, current verification, known gaps and last meaningful exercise.
observability.debugging: One trace from work order/Page 0 through stage events, receipts, Harness handoff and verifier result.

securityAuthority.candidate: ultra-v1-candidate may absorb migrated protections but remains non-production.
securityAuthority.promotion: Separate gated process with regression and explicit owner approval.
securityAuthority.deletion: No authority-bearing path is removed by a worker without a reviewed simplification proposal.

implementationSlices.name: Mechanism inventory
implementationSlices.deliverable: Machine-readable inventory of every authority/reasoning/observability mechanism and its consumers.

implementationSlices.name: Exercise map
implementationSlices.deliverable: Trace which mechanisms are actually exercised by current Pulse/Beam/Refinery workflows.

implementationSlices.name: Semantic compression
implementationSlices.deliverable: Rename/re-document confusing mechanisms and collapse proven maintenance debt behind compatibility adapters.

implementationSlices.name: Ultra persistence
implementationSlices.deliverable: Persistent append-only Ultra authority ledger if evidence says Ultra remains the target.
implementationSlices.releaseGate: Recovery, stale receipt and corruption tests pass.

implementationSlices.name: Generated maintenance truth
implementationSlices.deliverable: CI emits a machine-readable MaintenanceReceipt consumed by Pulse/Citadel.

implementationSlices.name: Promotion decision
implementationSlices.deliverable: Evidence packet comparing v44 and Ultra.
implementationSlices.releaseGate: Explicit owner decision; no automatic promotion.

acceptance: Every retained Funnel mechanism has an explicit job, owner, consumer and verification path.
Every proposed removal has a regression-backed replacement or proof of redundancy.
Documentation and 3D state can no longer imply implementation/verification without evidence.
CI reports station-level Funnel health independently of unrelated UI failures.
The production authority remains unambiguous throughout migration.
Maintenance complexity decreases measurably without degrading Page 0 fidelity or anti-bypass guarantees.
rollback: Each simplification ships behind versioned contracts/adapters; retain the prior authority path until replacement verification and owner release.

implementationStatus.FM-01: implemented-and-tested — funnel-mechanism-inventory.json inventories owners, consumers, tests, authority effects and maintenance classes without behavior changes
